audit.whatIsWrong: TRICKY at 7.5/10 does not match a 54.92% Emerald+ win rate over 122 games — the largest sample in this slice.
audit.why: 122 games is enough to trust; 54.9% is a favoured lane, not a 7.5/10 one.
audit.corrected: Nearer 5/10 and favoured, with the difficulty concentrated in his 2-item All Out window rather than the lane as a whole.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart gives K'Sante Levels 2 and 3, but spikes[0] on the same page says the Q-recast double-hit 'chunks him twice for free' at exactly those levels.
audit.why: Ntofo Strikes reaches 450, Twofold Hex 900. Before he has All Out he cannot close that gap.
audit.corrected: Levels 2 and 3 should read Aurora, matching the page's own spike text.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two errors. spikes[0] says Path Maker blocks the missile — Riot's text says he takes REDUCED damage while charging, not that it blocks anything. And the Level 6 plan claims Between Worlds makes Aurora untargetable from outside the rift, which Between Worlds does not do.
audit.why: Path Maker: 'K'Sante charges up, taking reduced damage, then dashes, knocking back and stunning enemies.' Between Worlds: damage, slow, and a teleport across the zone.
audit.corrected: Path Maker reduces his damage taken while charging, so poke into it is wasted, not blocked. At 6 the rift wins by slowing him inside it and letting you cross as he commits.

audit.whatIsWrong: Ntofo Strikes' two-stack shockwave PULLS you in, and it is on a 3.5s cooldown — the shortest cooldown in the matchup and his actual engage. It appears nowhere. Also absent: while All Out, Path Maker no longer knocks back or stuns, and All Out reduces his own resistances.
audit.why: Riot's text: Q 'At 2 stacks, K'Sante fires a shockwave that pulls enemies in'; W 'When All Out... no longer knocks back or stuns'; R '...at the cost of reduced defenses'.
audit.corrected: Count his Ntofo stacks, not his cooldowns — the second one pulls. Once he is All Out his W has no stun and his resistances are down, so that is when your burst actually lands.

audit.whatIsWrong: No numbers. The block calls All Out 'matchup-defining' without its 120s rank-1 cooldown, and never mentions the 3.5s Q or the 10s Footwork shield.
audit.why: K'Sante Q 3.5 flat, W 14s, E 10s, R 120/100/80.
audit.corrected: All Out 120s at rank 1; Path Maker 14s; Footwork 10s; Ntofo Strikes 3.5s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing warns that stacking flat magic penetration or raw damage against his early armour/HP build is the wrong read once All Out flips his resistances into damage.
audit.why: champ-data/_kits/_missing/aurora.json flags K'Sante under resistances-invalidated via Path Maker, and All Out explicitly trades defenses for damage.
audit.corrected: His resistances are a lane-phase problem that his own ult removes — hold burst for the All Out window rather than itemising around his tank stats.

edits.after: All Out strips his own resistances and takes the stun off Path Maker — that is when your burst lands. It is 120s at rank 1, so punish the miss.

notes: champ-data/_kits/_missing/aurora.json lists K'Sante under 'shield-absorbs-burst' for Footwork (E) and 'autoreset-burst-tell' for Dauntless Instinct (P). Both check out against Riot's text (E 'dashes and gains a shield'; P marks targets to take more damage 'on his next Attack'), so I used them. It also lists 'needs-antiheal' via All Out — Riot's text does say All Out grants healing, so anti-heal is defensible, but the healing is ult-gated rather than continuous, and I kept the existing anti-heal line rather than promoting it. The 'untargetable' claim I removed here is champion-wide: 61 occurrences in champ-data/content/aurora.js.
